subject: API requests failing with 401 unauthorized
description: Our production integration started failing this morning. All API requests are returning 401 unauthorized even though the API key was working yesterday.
error_message: 401 Unauthorized - Invalid or expired API token
expected_behavior: API requests should authenticate successfully using the configured API key.

subject: Webhook events are not being delivered
description: Webhook delivery appears delayed or failing for order.created events. Our endpoint is available, but we are not receiving events consistently.
error_message: Webhook delivery failed after retry attempts
expected_behavior: Order creation events should be delivered to the configured webhook endpoint.
actual_behavior: Webhook delivery is inconsistent and some events are missing.

subject: Python SDK returns configuration error
description: We are testing the Python SDK in staging and receiving a configuration error when initializing the client.
business_impact: Staging validation is blocked, but production is unaffected.

subject: Payment API timing out in production
description: Payment API calls are timing out during checkout. This is affecting live customers.
expected_behavior: Payment API should respond within normal latency thresholds.
actual_behavior: Requests are timing out with 504 errors.

subject: API requests blocked by rate limits
description: Our integration is receiving 429 responses. We need help understanding whether this is expected usage enforcement or a configuration issue.
expected_behavior: API requests should process within our expected usage limits.
actual_behavior: Requests are blocked by rate limiting.

subject: CRM records are not syncing
description: Customer records are failing to sync between our CRM and your platform. The sync job reports partial failures.
error_message: Partial sync failure - invalid field mapping
expected_behavior: All customer records should sync successfully.
actual_behavior: Some records fail due to invalid field mapping.
business_impact: Sales and support teams may see outdated customer data.
